integrity: The general statements follow from an explicit affine-group isomorphism, unit orbits on translation quotients and on additive characters, and the ordinary little-group theorem. Six direct finite-ring enumerations and symbolic class/degree sum identities corroborate them. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Requires a finite commutative local ring with nonzero square-zero maximal ideal. Character degrees and conjugacy class-size multiplicities are classified, not all ordinary character values. Prior-publication equivalence cannot be fully excluded; finite checks illustrate but do not prove the general statement.
title: Conjugacy and character-degree spectra of rank-two Borel groups over square-zero local rings
